name: Haven Blue Dolphin Holiday Park
stayType: Holiday park with caravans, lodges and touring
accommodation: Caravans (Saver to Signature Gold), Emerald and Diamond lodges; touring and camping pitches
beachAccess: No direct beach access; nearest sandy beach about two miles; sloped coastal path to Filey beach about three miles
confirmedFeatures: Indoor and outdoor pools, SportsDrome with climbing wall, fishing lake, soft play, crazy golf, restaurant, supermarket
overview: A large Haven park on the clifftop at Gristhorpe, between Cayton Bay and Filey, with caravans, lodges and touring pitches. It has indoor and outdoor pools, a fishing lake and a SportsDrome, and welcomes dogs. There is no direct beach access; the nearest sand is about two miles away.
surfTripFit: A big-facility family base within a short drive of both Cayton Bay and Filey, handy if you want to chase whichever is working.
